Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Faulkner
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 03/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 339 as introduced would exempt any sales through computer operated internet auctions from regulation by the State Board of Auctioneers, which are currently not regulated by practice of the board. This bill will not directly affect state or local funding.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 339 as passed the House of Representatives would exempt any sales through computer operated internet auctions from regulation by the State Board of Auctioneers, which are currently not regulated by practice of the board. This bill will not directly affect state or local funding.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
